lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters arranged in at least four distinct horizontal rows along the lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits. The spacing between clusters in the central rows is approximately uniform, forming a rectangular grid-like arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a lattice pattern where the blobs function as anchor nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and shadow-intensity pixels on the ventral edge of each ridge line.
